cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Be There for Me
cards.instruction: Get someone to show up, help, or stay involved as proof that the connection still matters.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Dad, I've put a red dot on your invitation like you did on that sculpture label. Your place at my opening is reserved.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The dot means sold. I was marking a sale for you, not booking a seat.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course, the sales dot. Keep the invitation; I still want you beside me when people come in.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your mother will be there. We haven't spoken since the divorce.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Come before we open. Help me unpack the biggest piece; I want a bit of tonight with you in it too.

reason: Use misunderstood display mark while retaining father presence and divorce-sensitive earlier participation from the seed.
